app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

final_report.root_cause: The frontend Deployment was misconfigured: the frontend's outbound address environment variable (FRONTEND_ADDR) was set to 'frontend:8080' instead of the proxy (frontend-proxy:8080) or the correct downstream service addresses. As a result outbound calls from the frontend resolved back to the frontend service, causing the frontend to re-enter itself and produce amplified frontend <-> frontend-proxy handoffs and long, looping end-to-end traces (~15s). This configuration-induced self-call loop (introduced by the incorrect Deployment env var) is the direct cause of the high end-to-end latency and repeated handoffs.
final_report.evidence_summary: High-latency traces (examples: trace 40c2852f..., 6a788fb0..., 951d399b...) show repeated frontend -> frontend-proxy -> frontend sequences and many downstream hops (product-catalog, cart, checkout, currency, payment, shipping) with has_error=true and latencies ~15,000 ms. kubectl_describe on deployment/frontend reveals FRONTEND_ADDR=frontend:8080 in container environment variables. Frontend pod logs show repeated internal API requests and recurring trace IDs consistent with request re-entry. kubectl_describe on service/frontend-proxy shows the proxy Service is correctly configured (ClusterIP, selector opentelemetry.io/name=frontend-proxy, endpoints at 10.244.1.21:8080). frontend-proxy pod logs show normal Envoy startup (13 clusters, 1 listener) and no evidence of an Envoy-configured routing loop. Together these confirm a frontend-side misconfiguration (self-addressing) caused calls to resolve to the frontend itself and produced the observed looping/amplified traces.
final_report.investigation_summary: Priority-1 investigation inspected frontend Deployment and logs, identifying FRONTEND_ADDR=frontend:8080 and log evidence of repeated self-handling of requests (completed). Priority-2 cross-checked frontend's configured target vs frontend-proxy Service and confirmed the proxy Service is correctly named and healthy; this established a name/port mismatch (frontend pointing to itself rather than frontend-proxy) (completed). Priority-3 inspected frontend-proxy (Envoy) for runtime/mounted config loops and proxy logs — no proxy-side loop or misconfiguration was found (completed). No pod crash/events or platform-level failures were observed; traces and Deployment env show a configuration error in frontend as the proximate cause. Given these completed, corroborating tasks, the root cause is confidently localized to the frontend Deployment configuration and no further tasks are required.
